_comment: Bugcrowd-shaped scope template — the canonical FEED for `main.py init`.
Works with --format bugcrowd_json for ANY platform (HackerOne, Bugcrowd,
YesWeHack, Intigriti): copy the program's scope into 'targets', pass the
right --platform for the attribution header. Field mapping in README.md.
Rules: 'name' starting with '*. ' -> wildcard; anything else -> exact.
'category' becomes the rule description; 'in_scope' routes the list.
Extra keys (like these _comment lines) are ignored by the importer.
